verdict.rationale: Spline's closest path to API-driven editing is its official MCP server, which drives the open editor from Claude, Cursor and similar clients, but it is bundled only in the desktop app and works through an open editor tab. The Code API, Real-time API and webhooks only control exported or running scenes at runtime, and the probe found no OpenAPI or public REST spec. Nothing documents that the MCP server or the APIs cover everything the UI can do. Missing for 10: a documented headless/public API for file and editor operations, evidence of UI-to-API parity (e.g. a tool or endpoint coverage list), an OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.
